selected_script.angle: Organizing laundry room clutter on the washing machine side using heavy-duty magnetic shelves
selected_script.hook: Your laundry room is messy because you are ignoring this giant blank metal space.

segment_01.voiceover: Your laundry room is messy because you're ignoring this giant blank metal space on your machine. Let's fix that instantly.

segment_02.voiceover: These matte black carbon steel racks hold up to eleven pounds. They stick firmly without drilling, perfect for heavy detergents.

segment_03.voiceover: Plus, the detachable hooks hold your brush or spray bottle. Click below to reclaim your organized space today!
